data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘a’wfa, meaning to support, help, or aid. In Islamic tradition, Eifa represents the concept of providing strength and assistance during times of need. The name Eifa carries the meaning “Support, Aid” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Eifa usually hope their child will grow to embody support, aid and live with faith, good character and purpose.

This spiritual attribute is highly prized in Islamic culture as it leads to better character development, improved social relations, and a more harmonious existence. By carrying this name, one is continually inspired to put faith into practice by helping and supporting others.
